packages.description: List of packages to pre-select for reconfiguration via configure-debian frontend. Each entry specifies a package name and optional frontend override. Only 'name' is required; 'frontend' is optional and falls back to system default or global setting if omitted. Corresponds to the set of packages configure-debian presents in interactive mode and the packages passed to dpkg-reconfigure internally when invoked on their behalf. Based on documented --list and dpkg-reconfigure behavior in configure-debian(8).

default_priority.description: Debconf priority threshold for interactive prompts. Controls which questions are shown during reconfiguration. Matches the priority levels documented for debconf (low|medium|high|critical). See debconf(7) and dpkg-reconfigure(1).

global_frontend.description: Optional global override for the Debconf frontend (e.g., 'noninteractive', 'readline'). If set, it overrides the default interactive frontend used by configure-debian. See dpkg-reconfigure(1) --frontend for options.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug output during configure-debian operation. Corresponds to dpkg-reconfigure's --debug= flag family when passed through.

packages[].name.description: Debian package name to be included in the configure-debian list and passed to dpkg-reconfigure. Must be a valid installed package name.

packages[].frontend.description: Optional frontend override for this specific package (e.g., 'dialog', 'readline', 'noninteractive'). If omitted, the default global or system frontend is used. Matches dpkg-reconfigure(1) --frontend behavior per invocation.
